contentText:
Netflix is starting to roll out a big revamp of its mobile app, and a central feature is a new vertical video feed called "Clips" where you can scroll through clips of shows, movies, and other Netflix content.

The idea of the Clips feed is that it can help you discover new things to watch in a mobile-friendly format. The company started testing a vertical video feed last year, saying at the time that "we know that swiping through a vertical feed on social media apps is an easy way to browse video content."
